name: Nurse Gift Can Glass (16 oz)
seoTitle: Nurse Can Glass Gift for Iced Coffee
metaDescription: A 16 oz can shaped glass for nurses who love iced coffee. A fun gift for Nurses Week, graduation, retirement, or a nursing student birthday.
summary: A trendy 16 oz can glass for the nurse who runs on iced coffee. A fresh alternative to the usual nurse mug for Nurses Week or graduation.
whyItWorks: If you have noticed a nurse walking into shift with a giant iced coffee, you already know why a can glass makes sense. The can shape has become a favorite for iced lattes, cold brew, and smoothies, and it looks great on a kitchen counter or in photos. For a nurse who has received a dozen mugs over the years, it is a welcome change.

At 16 oz, it holds a solid serving for a slow morning before a night shift or a relaxing day off. Glass is best kept at home rather than tossed in a work bag, so think of it as a treat for their downtime. It fits many moments: Nurses Week, a birthday, graduation from nursing school, or retirement. Make it feel complete by adding a reusable straw, a bag of cold brew coffee, or a gift card to their favorite coffee shop. It is a small gift that feels current, which is not always easy to find in nurse themed presents.
goodToKnow: Check the listing for the design printed on the glass and whether a lid or straw is included.
Glass is better for home than a busy unit, so pair it with a tumbler if they need something for work.
Hand washing usually helps printed glassware last, so check care notes on the listing.

faq.q: Does it come with a lid and straw?
faq.a: The title does not mention them, so check the listing. A reusable straw is an easy add on if not.

faq.q: Is a glass practical for a nurse at work?
faq.a: It is better suited to home. For shifts, an insulated tumbler with a lid is more practical.
